description:
{"time": 1783112274566, "blocks": [{"id": "taa23k6vat", "data": {"text": "For years, NMOA SACCO \u2014 the Nairobi Matatu Owners Association \u2014 ran Route 111 on pure function. Reliable service, Nairobi to Ngong town, no frills. Then the mega-fleets arrived on Ngong Road and the rules changed overnight. Rival saccos flooded the corridor with heavily customised nganya, bass-heavy sound rigs, and neon graffiti designed to pull the city's youth away from anything that looked ordinary. NMOA had a choice: adapt or be left behind."}, "type": "paragraph"}, {"id": "d2pyr2tti8", "data": {"text": "Attitude was their answer \u2014 and the name said everything. Aggressive geometric patterns, commanding high-contrast typography, custom body fabrication that turned heads from the opposite lane. This wasn't just a matatu keeping up; it was proof that NMOA could own the nganya street culture on pure swagger."}, "type": "paragraph"}, {"id": "ov66jmgtn8", "data": {"text": "Muraguri's woodblock reduction preserves that energy in print.
